//: Turns on type checking for plain JavaScript, so `tedi.d.ts` actually bites: a typo in a `ctx.*` call is a red squiggle in the editor instead of a runtime TypeError inside an async onClick, which is the single most common way an extension breaks invisibly. No install needed - any TypeScript-aware editor reads this file. `types: []` is here because this folder sits inside the TEDI repo, whose node_modules is on the resolution path: without it tsc pulls in every @types package it finds up there and type-checks their JavaScript. The extension imports nothing but tedi.d.ts and the DOM.
